contents.content:
<script>
  // Tylko kolejka i funkcje pomocnicze. SDK (oaiq.min.js), init i zgodę ładuje dodatek „consent”.
  // Bez consent false: w SDK consent false kasuje cookie __oppref (ID kliknięcia reklamy) i __obref,
  // więc wołane na każdej stronie odcinało zakupy od kliknięć w ChatGPT Ads.
  (function (w) {
    if (w.oaiq) return;
    var q = function () {
      q.q.push(arguments);
    };
    q.q = [];
    w.oaiq = q;
  })(window);

  // Bufor do czasu zgody. Dodatki dynamiczne IdoSell wstrzykuje w losowej kolejności.
  window.oaiqConsentGranted = window.oaiqConsentGranted || false;
  window.oaiqBuffer = window.oaiqBuffer || [];

  // Waluta ze zmiennej kampanii „currency” (domyślnie PLN).
  window.oaiqCurrency = (function (c) {
    c = String(c || '').trim().toUpperCase();
    return /^[A-Z]{3}$/.test(c) ? c : 'PLN';
  })('[config:currency]');

  window.oaiqSafe = function () {
    try {
      if (window.oaiqConsentGranted) {
        window.oaiq.apply(window, arguments);
      } else {
        window.oaiqBuffer.push(arguments);
      }
    } catch (e) {}
  };

  // Tekst z <template> (nazwy produktów, dane klienta) — bez ryzyka apostrofów w kodzie JS.
  window.oaiqText = function (selector) {
    const el = document.querySelector(selector);
    if (!el) return '';
    const text = (el.content ? el.content.textContent : el.textContent) || '';
    return text.trim();
  };

  // Kwota w groszach (OpenAI: liczba całkowita, np. 2599 = 25,99).
  window.oaiqAmount = function (value) {
    const number = parseFloat(String(value).replace(',', '.').replace(/\s/g, ''));
    return isNaN(number) ? 0 : Math.round(number * 100);
  };

  // Lista towarów z ukrytego kontenera wypełnionego pętlą [iai:foreach_products_begin].
  window.oaiqItems = function (containerSelector) {
    const container = document.querySelector(containerSelector);
    if (!container) return [];
    return Array.from(container.querySelectorAll('[data-oaiq-id]')).map(function (item) {
      const entry = {
        id: item.getAttribute('data-oaiq-id'),
        content_type: 'product',
        quantity: Math.max(1, Math.round(parseFloat(item.getAttribute('data-oaiq-qty')) || 1)),
        amount: window.oaiqAmount(item.getAttribute('data-oaiq-price')),
        currency: window.oaiqCurrency || 'PLN'
      };
      const name = (item.textContent || '').trim();
      if (name) entry.name = name;
      return entry;
    });
  };
</script>
[ChatGPT Ads] consent - wymaga zgody na cookies reklamowe

<script>
  // Wywoływane po zgodzie na pliki cookies (reklamowe). Dopiero tu ładuje się SDK OpenAI:
  // bez zgody nie ma zapytań ani cookies. Potem wysyłka zdarzeń zebranych wcześniej w buforze.
  try {
    // Pixel ID ze zmiennej kampanii „pixel_id”. Pusty → SDK się nie ładuje.
    const pixelId = String('[config:pixel_id]').trim();
    if (window.oaiq && !window.oaiqConsentGranted && /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,}$/.test(pixelId)) {
      oaiq('init', {
        pixelId: pixelId
      });
      oaiq('consent', true);

      // ID kliknięcia reklamy ze strony wejścia: zgodę kliknięto na stronie z ?oppref=,
      // a ten dodatek IdoSell wstawia dopiero na następnej stronie (bez oppref w adresie).
      try {
        const hasUrlOppref = new URLSearchParams(location.search).has('oppref');
        const hasCookieOppref = /(?:^|;\s*)__oppref=/.test(document.cookie);
        if (!hasUrlOppref && !hasCookieOppref && document.referrer) {
          const ref = new URL(document.referrer);
          const landingOppref = ref.host === location.host ? (ref.searchParams.get('oppref') || '').trim() : '';
          if (landingOppref) {
            oaiq('init', { oppref: landingOppref });
          }
        }
      } catch (e) {}

      if (!document.querySelector('script[data-oaiq-sdk]')) {
        const js = document.createElement('script');
        js.async = true;
        js.src = 'https://bzrcdn.openai.com/sdk/oaiq.min.js';
        js.setAttribute('data-oaiq-sdk', '1');
        const f = document.getElementsByTagName('script')[0];
        f.parentNode.insertBefore(js, f);
      }

      window.oaiqConsentGranted = true;
      (window.oaiqBuffer || []).splice(0).forEach(function (args) {
        oaiq.apply(window, args);
      });
    }
  } catch (e) {}
</script>

<template id="oaiq-product-name">[iai:itemcardpage_product_name]</template>
<script>
  (function () {
    if (!window.oaiqSafe) return;
    const amount = oaiqAmount('[iai:itemcardpage_product_price_gross_float]');
    const product = {
      id: '[iai:itemcardpage_product_id]',
      content_type: 'product',
      quantity: 1,
      amount: amount,
      currency: window.oaiqCurrency || 'PLN'
    };
    const name = oaiqText('#oaiq-product-name');
    if (name) product.name = name;

    oaiqSafe('measure', 'contents_viewed', {
      type: 'contents',
      amount: amount,
      currency: window.oaiqCurrency || 'PLN',
      contents: [product]
    });
  })();
</script>

<template id="oaiq-atc-name">[iai:itemcardpage_product_name]</template>
<script>
  (function () {
    const button = document.querySelector('#projector_button_basket');
    if (!button || !window.oaiqSafe || button.getAttribute('data-oaiq-bound')) return;
    button.setAttribute('data-oaiq-bound', '1');

    button.addEventListener('click', function () {
      try {
        const quantityInput = document.querySelector('#projector_number, input[name="number"]');
        const quantity = Math.max(1, Math.round(parseFloat(quantityInput ? quantityInput.value : 1) || 1));
        const unitAmount = oaiqAmount('[iai:itemcardpage_product_price_gross_float]');
        const product = {
          id: '[iai:itemcardpage_product_id]',
          content_type: 'product',
          quantity: quantity,
          amount: unitAmount,
          currency: window.oaiqCurrency || 'PLN'
        };
        const name = oaiqText('#oaiq-atc-name');
        if (name) product.name = name;

        oaiqSafe('measure', 'items_added', {
          type: 'contents',
          amount: unitAmount * quantity,
          currency: window.oaiqCurrency || 'PLN',
          contents: [product]
        });
      } catch (e) {}
    });
  })();
</script>
